units.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. The ruling in an administrative offence case shall be signed by the judge, the person presiding at the meeting of the collegial body, or the official who issued the ruling.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 29.10

units.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.11

units.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.11

units.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case shall be announced immediately upon completion of consideration of the case. In exceptional cases, by decision of the person (body) considering the administrative offence case, preparation of a reasoned ruling may be deferred for no more than three days from the day the hearing ends, except in administrative offence cases specified in parts 3 - 5 of Article 29.6 of this Code; the operative part of the ruling shall nevertheless be announced immediately upon completion of consideration of the case. The day the ruling is prepared in full shall be the day it is issued.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.11

units.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. A copy of the ruling in an administrative offence case shall be handed against acknowledgement of receipt to the individual, the individual’s legal representative or the legal representative of the legal entity in respect of whom it was issued, and also to the victim upon request, or sent to those persons by registered post or electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the manner and cases provided for by Article 24.9 of this Code, within three days from the day the ruling was issued.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.11

units.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: A copy of a ruling in an administrative offence case issued by a judge shall be sent to the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record or to the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up that record, within three days from the day the ruling was issued.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.11 · “A copy of a ruling in an administrative offence case issued by…”

units.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2.1. A copy of the procedural order specified in point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code, together with the case materials, shall be sent on the day that procedural order is issued to the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record, the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up that record, the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted, and also the victim and prosecutor if participating.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 29.11

units.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. In cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 20.8, 20.9 and 20.12 of this Code against a person to whom firearms and ammunition (cartridges) have been entrusted in connection with the performance of official duties or provided for temporary use by an organisation, a copy of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall be sent to the relevant organisation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.11

units.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. In cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 18.9, 18.15 and 18.17 of this Code against an organisation that is a member of a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities, a copy of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall be sent to that self-regulatory organisation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.11

units.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. In cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 6.9 and part 2 of Article 20.20 of this Code, a copy of the ruling terminating proceedings in the administrative offence case on the ground provided for by the note to Article 6.9 of this Code, or imposing an administrative penalty with an obligation to undergo diagnostics, preventive measures, treatment for drug addiction and/or medical and/or social rehabilitation in connection with consumption of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor’s prescription, shall be sent to the relevant medical organisation or social rehabilitation institution.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 29.11

units.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 6. In cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by part 6 of Article 11.17 of this Code, a copy of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall be sent to the carrier on board whose aircraft the relevant administrative offence was committed.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 29.11

units.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 7. Copies of the rulings provided for by points 3 - 5 of part 1 of Article 29.9 of this Code shall, no later than the day following the day those rulings enter into legal force, be sent to the judge (body) to whom the procedural order requesting materials of the administrative offence case specified in part 1 of Article 24.10 of this Code was sent, and to the body whose official sent the record of an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code and the attached materials specified in point 1 or 2 of part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 29.11

units.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
units.text: 8. A copy of the ruling provided for by point 4 or 5 of part 1 of Article 29.9 of this Code shall, no later than one day after the day the relevant ruling enters into legal force, be sent to the body or official authorised to enforce the ruling imposing an administrative penalty in the administrative offence case in which proceedings have been terminated in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 29.11

units.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.12

units.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 29.12

units.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. A procedural order in an administrative offence case shall specify:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.12

units.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) the position, surname and initials of the judge or official, or the name and membership of the collegial body, that issued the procedural order;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 29.12

units.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) the date and place of consideration of the application, motion or case materials;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 29.12

units.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) particulars of the person who submitted the application or motion or in respect of whom the case materials were considered;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 29.12

units.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) the content of the application or motion;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 29.12

units.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) the circumstances established during consideration of the application, motion or case materials;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 29.12

units.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
units.text: 6) the decision adopted following consideration of the application, motion or case materials.
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 29.12

units.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. A procedural order in an administrative offence case issued by a collegial body shall be adopted by a simple majority of the votes of members of the collegial body present at the meeting.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.12

units.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. The procedural order in an administrative offence case shall be signed by the judge, the person presiding at the meeting of the collegial body, or the official who issued the procedural order.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.12

units.locator: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors
units.text: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors
units.label: Art. 29.12.1

units.locator: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors
units.label: Art. 29.12.1

units.locator: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors
units.text: 1. The judge, body or official that issued a ruling or procedural order in an administrative offence case may, upon an application by the persons specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.5.1 and 25.11 of this Code, an enforcement bailiff, or a body or official enforcing the ruling or procedural order in the administrative offence case, or on their own initiative, correct clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors in the ruling or procedural order without changing its content.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.12.1

units.locator: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors
units.text: 2. Clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors in a ruling or decision adopted following consideration of appeals or protests against a ruling or decision in an administrative offence case shall be corrected in accordance with the procedure established by this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.12.1

units.locator: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors
units.text: 3. A clerical error, typographical error or arithmetic error shall be corrected by a procedural order.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.12.1

units.locator: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors
units.text: 4. A copy of the procedural order concerning corrections made to a ruling or procedural order in an administrative offence case, and a copy of the procedural order concerning corrections made to a ruling or decision adopted following consideration of appeals or protests against a ruling or decision in an administrative offence case, shall, within three days from the day the relevant procedural order is issued, be sent to the persons specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.5.1 and 25.11 of this Code, the enforcement bailiff, or the body or official enforcing the ruling or procedural order in the administrative offence case, if they submitted the relevant application.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.12.1

units.locator: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors
units.text: 5. A copy of a procedural order issued by a judge concerning corrections made to a ruling in an administrative offence case or to the procedural orders specified in point 4 of part 1 of Article 29.4 and point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code shall be sent to the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record or to the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up that record, within three days from the day the relevant procedural order is issued.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 29.12.1

units.locator: Article 29.13. Formal submission to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to commission of an administrative offence
units.text: Article 29.13. Formal submission to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to commission of an administrative offence
units.label: Art. 29.13

units.locator: Article 29.13. Formal submission to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to commission of an administrative offence
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.13. Formal submission to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to commission of an administrative offence
units.label: Art. 29.13

units.locator: Article 29.13. Formal submission to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to commission of an administrative offence
units.text: 1. Upon establishing the causes of an administrative offence and the conditions contributing to its commission, the judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case shall submit a formal submission to the relevant organisations and officials to take measures to eliminate those causes and conditions.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.13

units.locator: Article 29.13. Formal submission to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to commission of an administrative offence
units.text: 2. Organisations and officials shall consider a formal submission to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to commission of an administrative offence within one month from the day it is received and inform the judge, body or official that submitted it of the measures taken.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.13

units.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
units.text: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
units.label: Art. 29.14

units.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
units.label: Art. 29.14

units.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
units.text: 1. Where a judge has recognised as mandatory the presence of a participant in administrative offence proceedings during consideration of the administrative offence case, but that participant cannot be present for objective reasons, the judge shall, upon a motion by the participant or on the judge’s own initiative, decide on that person’s participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems, where technically possible.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.14

units.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
units.text: 2. Courts’ videoconferencing systems may be used in the court at the place of residence, stay or location of a participant in administrative offence proceedings whose presence has been recognised as mandatory but who cannot attend consideration of the administrative offence case. To ensure participation in consideration of an administrative offence case of persons in places of custody or imprisonment, places where administrative arrest is served, special institutions for holding foreign citizens and stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of forced expulsion from the Russian Federation, deportation or readmission, or places of compulsory confinement of bodies authorised to carry out administrative detention, the videoconferencing systems of the relevant bodies and institutions shall be used.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.14

units.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
units.text: 3. The judge shall issue a procedural order on participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of the administrative offence case by persons whose presence has been recognised as mandatory. Copies of that procedural order shall, no later than the working day following the day it is issued, be sent to the relevant participants in the administrative offence proceedings and to the relevant court, body or institution instructed to ensure a participant’s participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.14

units.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
units.text: 4. The judge considering an administrative offence case shall establish a connection with the court, body or institution ensuring participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of the administrative offence case by a person whose presence has been recognised as mandatory. A judge, an official authorised to consider administrative offence cases, or an employee of the institution shall ensure a participant’s participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.14

units.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
units.text: The judge, official or employee of the institution ensuring participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems shall assist the judge considering the administrative offence case in checking attendance and establishing the identity of the persons appearing, and in performing other procedural actions, in particular obtaining from the victim, witnesses, specialists, experts and interpreters written acknowledgements that the judge considering the administrative offence case has explained their rights and duties and warned them of liability for failure to perform them, and receiving written materials from participants in the administrative offence proceedings.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.14 · “The judge, official or employee of the institution ensuring…”

units.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
units.text: 5. All documents received at the court, body or institution ensuring participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems shall be sent to the court considering that case no later than the working day following the day the administrative offence case was considered.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 29.14

units.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
units.text: 6. The judge considering an administrative offence case shall refuse a motion to participate in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems where:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 29.14

units.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
units.text: 1) there is no technical capability for participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 29.14

units.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
units.text: 2) a decision has been adopted to consider the administrative offence case in a closed hearing.
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 29.14

units.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
units.text: 7. The rules established by this Article shall apply when a judge considers an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 29.14

units.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
units.text: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
units.label: Art. 29.15

units.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
units.label: Art. 29.15

units.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
units.text: 1. Where a body or official has recognised as mandatory the presence of a participant in administrative offence proceedings during consideration of the administrative offence case, but that participant cannot be present for objective reasons, the body or official shall, upon a motion by the participant in that case or on their own initiative, decide on that person’s participation in consideration of the case through videoconferencing systems, where technically possible.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.15

units.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
units.text: 2. Videoconferencing systems of bodies whose officials are authorised to consider administrative offence cases may be used at the body, structural subdivision of the body, territorial body or structural subdivision of the territorial body at the place of residence, stay or location of a participant in administrative offence proceedings whose presence has been recognised as mandatory but who cannot attend consideration of the case. To ensure participation in consideration of an administrative offence case of persons in places of custody or imprisonment, places where administrative arrest is served, special institutions for holding foreign citizens and stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of forced expulsion from the Russian Federation, deportation or readmission, or places of compulsory confinement of bodies authorised to carry out administrative detention, the videoconferencing systems of the relevant bodies and institutions shall be used.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29.15

units.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
units.text: 3. The body or official shall issue a procedural order on participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of the administrative offence case by persons whose presence has been recognised as mandatory. Copies of that procedural order shall, no later than the working day following the day it is issued, be sent to the relevant participants in the administrative offence proceedings and to the relevant body, structural subdivision of the body, territorial body, structural subdivision of the territorial body or institution instructed to ensure a participant’s participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29.15

units.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
units.text: 4. The body or official considering an administrative offence case shall establish a connection with the body, structural subdivision of the body, territorial body, structural subdivision of the territorial body or institution ensuring participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of the case by a person whose presence during consideration of that case has been recognised as mandatory. An official authorised to consider administrative offence cases or an employee of the institution shall ensure a participant’s participation in consideration of that administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.15

units.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
units.text: The official or employee of the institution ensuring participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems shall assist the body or official considering the case in checking attendance and establishing the identity of the persons appearing, and in performing other procedural actions, in particular obtaining from the victim, witnesses, specialists, experts and interpreters written acknowledgements that the body or official considering the case has explained their rights and duties and warned them of liability for failure to perform them, and receiving written materials from participants in the administrative offence proceedings.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29.15 · “The official or employee of the institution ensuring…”

units.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
units.text: 5. All documents received at the body, structural subdivision of the body, territorial body, structural subdivision of the territorial body or institution ensuring participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems shall be sent to the body or official considering that case no later than the working day following the day the administrative offence case was considered.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 29.15

units.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
units.text: 6. The body or official considering an administrative offence case shall refuse a motion to participate in consideration of the case through videoconferencing systems where:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 29.15

units.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
units.text: 1) there is no technical capability for participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 29.15

units.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
units.text: 2) a decision has been adopted to consider the administrative offence case in a closed hearing.
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 29.15

units.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
units.text: 7. The rules established by this Article shall apply when a body or official considers an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 29.15

units.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system
units.text: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system
units.label: Art. 29.16

units.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system
units.label: Art. 29.16

units.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system
units.text: 1. Participants in administrative offence proceedings may participate in consideration of the case through a web-conferencing system upon their motion or on the initiative of the judge, body or official considering the case, provided that the participants in that case have the technical capability, where proper consideration and resolution of the case require the participation of a person who cannot participate for objective reasons, and provided that the court, body or official has the technical capability to conduct a web conference.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.16

units.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system
units.text: The judge, body or official shall issue a procedural order on participation of the persons specified in the first paragraph of this part in consideration of the administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system, stating the time of consideration of the case. The information necessary for participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system shall be sent to the relevant participants in the proceedings in advance in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 25.15 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29.16 · “The judge, body or official shall issue a procedural order on…”
